prerequisites: Must have passed Manufacturing Methods course
Must have passed Machine Elements course
Computer Applications in Mechanical Engineering course is recommended

learning_outcomes.text: They know Computer Aided Manufacturing Hardware.
They can define the solid modeling - manufacturing process flow.
They can use Computer Aided Manufacturing Software.

syllabus_topics: Material Removal by Facing Method on CNC Lathe (Software)
Drilling and Internal Surface Machining Method on CNC Lathe (Software)
Material Removal by Face Machining Method on CNC Mill (Software)
Material Removal by Rough Machining Method on CNC Mill (Software)
Material Removal by Finish Machining Method on CNC Mill (Software)
CNC Mill Post Processing (Software) and Application I (Machine)
Material Removal by Surface Machining Method on CNC Mill (Software)
Drilling and Threading Method on CNC Mill (Software)
Process Planning: Cutting die design and manufacturing application (Computer Software)
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with 50% from in-year success and 50% from the final exam. The in-year success is comprised of 80% midterm exam, 5% first quiz, 10% assignment, and 5% second quiz.
bibliography: Ümit KOCABIÇAK, "Bilgisayar Bütünleşik İmalat Ders Notları", Sakarya Üniversitesi, 2004.
CIM technology : Fundamentals and applications / Russell Biekert, contributing authors David Berling
CIM Computer integrated manufacturing [towards the factory of the future] / August-Wilhelm Scheer
Principles of computer-integrated manufacturing / S. Kant Vajpayee
